name: Siege Barge
piloting: Nature (DC 41 to 46 depending on the pulling creatures) or Sailing Lore (DC 39)
speed: the Speed of the slowest pulling creature (pulled by 4 Huge creatures)

items.name: Space
items.text: 60 feet long, 30 feet wide, 20 feet high

items.name: Sluggish
items.text: This vehicle must move twice its length for each 90-degree turn it makes.

items.name: Weapon Mounts
items.text: This vehicle has two weapon mounts. At purchase, these weapon mounts are initially empty. Installing or uninstalling a weapon into a mount requires 1 day, a successful DC 39 Crafting check check, and an appropriate weapon. The weapon mounts can be equipped with Huge or smaller ranged siege weapons.

text: These special barges were designed to siege river and oceanside fortresses and enemy encampments. In addition to carrying two huge siege weapons and their crews, these barges also hold a variety of stones and other siege projectiles.
